name: Akina Pharmacy
desc:
Customer Service Representative | $18-$22/hr | Inbound/Outbound, No Sales Expectations
Company: Akina Pharmacy
Industry: Healthcare / Specialty Compounding Pharmacy
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 Akina makes custom medications for patients when a standard, off-the-shelf prescription won't work for them, and you'd be the friendly voice making sure those orders actually get where they need to go. You'd handle a real mix of inbound and outbound calls plus live chat, confirming orders, scheduling deliveries, and answering questions from both patients and their healthcare providers. A big part of the job is accurate documentation, you're taking detailed notes in real time and routing anything urgent to the right person, like a pharmacist or pharmacy technician, when it's beyond what you can solve. This is genuinely fast-paced with real daily numbers attached, so it rewards someone who can stay warm and empathetic with patients while still hitting a quota.
assessment: Expect an assessment for typing, internet speed, ability to multitask or use simulations and generalized personality
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: Not stated in posting.
Required Experience: Minimum of 1 to 2 years of customer service experience, preferably in a call center or healthcare setting.
Preferred Experience: Healthcare or call center background specifically called out as preferred.
Required Skills:
Exceptional verbal and written communication for high-volume inbound and outbound work
Strong attention to detail and organization for accurately documenting patient information
Proficiency with CRM systems, phone systems, and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
Ability to multitask in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone with 1-2 years of customer service experience, especially from a call center or healthcare setting
Someone who genuinely enjoys patient-facing work and can stay warm and empathetic under a real daily quota
Someone detail-oriented enough to accurately document patient and provider information while juggling calls and chats
Someone motivated by clear, measurable performance goals and recognition for hitting them
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone without at least a year of customer service experience, since this isn't a true no-experience-needed role
Anyone who gets overwhelmed by firm daily call volume targets (50-60 outbound, 50-60 inbound, 100-120 documentation entries per day)
Anyone who prefers a slower-paced, less metrics-driven environment
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Patient and provider communication
Inbound and outbound call handling
Order confirmation and scheduling
CRM and phone system proficiency
Healthcare customer service
First-call resolution
Detail-oriented documentation
High-volume call center experience
Performance metrics
Microsoft Office proficiency
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 Application → Assessment → Phone screen → Final interview. Total time to hire averages 3 to 15 days.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your customer service experience, especially any call center or healthcare background.
How do you stay warm and empathetic with patients while also hitting daily call and documentation targets?
Walk us through how you accurately document detailed information while managing a high volume of calls.
Describe a time you had to escalate a patient issue to someone else on the team, like a pharmacist.
How do you handle a stressful, fast-paced day without letting quality slip?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $18 to $22/hr.
Shift: Full-time, remote. Specific hours not detailed in posting, confirm directly.
Benefits: Two medical plan options with employer premium contributions up to 85%, dental and vision coverage, accident and hospital indemnity coverage, company-paid short and long-term disability (available after 30 days), generous PTO, six paid holidays, 401(k) match up to 4%, a rewards and recognition program, and no-cost prescribed compounded medications after 30 days of employment.
Equipment Provided: Not stated in posting.
Felony Friendly?: Not stated.
Drug Test: Not stated.
Notes: This is a genuinely strong benefits package for a remote customer service role, especially the no-cost medication perk and the generous employer contribution toward medical coverage. The daily numbers (50-60 outbound calls, 50-60 inbound calls, 100-120 documentation entries) are real and firm, so it's worth being upfront with a participant that this is a high-volume, metrics-driven environment, not a laid-back support role. The 1-2 years of experience requirement means this isn't the right fit for someone with zero customer service background, but it's a solid step-up option for someone who's already proven themselves in an entry-level role and is ready for something with stronger pay and benefits.
Career Pathway: Not stated directly in posting. Reasonable inferred path: Customer Service Representative → Senior CSR → Team Lead → Customer Service Supervisor → Patient Experience Manager, though this is an estimate, not confirmed by Akina directly.
training: M-F, hours unknown at this time
